chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfaly, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The Hajj, its reward is Paradise, and the Umrah is an expiation for every sin.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of Hajj and Umrah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the unique status of Hajj as a direct path to Paradise, while characterizing Umrah as a comprehensive expiation for sins. This distinction reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the purifying power of Umrah as a frequent act of devotion that complements the once-in-a-lifetime obligation of Hajj.
